title: Partial refunds
description: A merchant can partially refund a successful payment. Network retries use the same request_id and must cause only one gateway refund. A new request_id may refund the same amount again, within the original payment total.
hints: Think about the same operation arriving twice.
A network timeout may cause the client to retry.
Is request_id checked before the external side effect?
template:
def test_first_operation(env):
    pay = env.make_payment(amount_cents=10_000)
    env.svc.refund(pay.id, 3_000, request_id="r-1")
    assert len(env.gateway.calls) == 1
